name: com.innov8tif.okaydoc.activity.FaceDetectionActivity
description: OkayDoc (Innov8tif document-authenticity SDK) opens a camera preview and checks live images for a face as part of its face-detection flow. The older release sends preview images to its face-check service.
disableEffect: An OkayDoc flow that needs this face check cannot finish if this screen is disabled.
